prior_summary: A learned DeepSets particle encoder pools bowl-relative and source-relative particle tokens, a causal auxiliary head regularizes settled/source/upright phase, and actions are local SE(3) residuals applied from each fresh TCP.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for secure grasps with ambiguous intermediate phase, early or late discharge, mid-tilt or mid-righting entry, or modest execution deviations. Particle, source, bowl and TCP observations must be reliable and the next local transform reachable.
termination_guidance: The auxiliary is not a success detector. Hand off only under the unchanged observed conditions: at least ten particles settled in the bowl, source approximately upright and held, and outbound motion begun. Nominal readiness is near 1680.
limitations: Local residuals are not an absolute far-destination anchor; use h01 for large bowl displacement. Particle geometry cannot supply hidden contact truth. No demonstration establishes spill, collision or grasp-loss recovery, and the phase head must not be used to override success evaluation.
